name: Logitech International S.A.
fiscal_calendar_note: Fiscal year ends March 31. Interim quarters are generally thirteen-week periods ending on a Friday; Logitech presents them as ending on the last day of the calendar quarter, and this pipeline uses that presentation.
segment_note: Designs and sells peripherals (mice, keyboards, gaming, video collaboration, webcams, headsets) through retail, e-commerce (including Amazon) and distributors worldwide. Amazon US reviews cover only part of global sales.
